request.deadline: 12 months after deployment; month-6 yield distribution; month-12 final return
deliverables: Deploy approximately 9,000,000 ADA worth of USDM liquidity into Strike Finance V2
Return realized yield from the first six months to the Cardano Treasury at month 6
Return 100% of treasury-owned deployed assets, including remaining principal and realized yield, at month 12

Provide monthly public transparency reports covering deployment status, liquidity utilization, volume, open interest, P&L, yield, drawdown, stablecoin exposure, market quality metrics, distributions, and material risks
Provide independent third-party assurance reports at deployment confirmation, month-6 distribution, and month-12 return
request.recipient: independent multisig council / Strike Finance liquidity deployment
request.what: 12-month productive treasury deployment into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure, with ADA sold for USDM to provide stablecoin-denominated liquidity

claims.claim: The proposal requests 9,000,000 ADA for a 12-month liquidity deployment rather than grant funding, with treasury ownership retained throughout deployment.
The deployed ADA will be sold for USDM, modeled at ADA = 0.15 USD for approximately 1,350,000 USDM of stablecoin liquidity, with actual USDM notional depending on deployment conversion price.
The proposal models a 10% USD-denominated annual percentage rate, generating approximately 135,000 USD or 900,000 ADA-equivalent in annual yield, while stating returns are not guaranteed.

Strike Finance states it has processed over 1.13 billion USD in cumulative volume, facilitated roughly one million trades, served over 3,000 unique traders, generated over 1.16 million USD in protocol revenue, and produced over 3.25 million USD in liquidity provider profit.

Strike V2 public performance figures are presented for 2026-03-20 through 2026-06-15, including 87,288,044 USD total V2 volume, 410,800 total V2 trades, 2,681 users, 30,105 USD total V2 revenue, and 1,246,007 USD peak open interest.

The proposal asserts that the primary bottleneck to further Strike growth is liquidity depth and that increased stablecoin liquidity has correlated with higher V2 volume, trades, revenue, and vault TVL.

Operational custody is proposed to be handled by an independent multisig council composed of Rami from Snek, Phil from Surf, and James from Monetra or Moneta, and Strike Finance will not have unilateral custody or control of treasury assets.
The proposal states that Christian Schmitz is conducting an official audit expected by July 1, 2026, and that the report will be published upon completion.

The proposal identifies risks including ADA price appreciation risk, USDM depeg or redemption risk, custody risk, smart contract risk, yield underperformance, and operational multisig risk, with governance review or wind-down triggers tied to drawdown and missed reporting.
The proposal targets 1,000,000,000 USD in 30-day volume, 5,000 traders, and a 5,000,000 USD annualized revenue run rate within 12 months.

summary: The document proposes a 9,000,000 ADA, 12-month treasury-owned liquidity deployment into Strike Finance V2 via USDM, administered by an independent multisig council, with modeled yield, public reporting, assurance reports, and return of principal plus realized yield, while acknowledging market, stablecoin, smart contract, custody, and underperformance risks.
